IMD_PUNE.name: India Meteorological Department (IMD) Pune / National Data Centre
IMD_PUNE.description: Official gridded rainfall (0.25° x 0.25°) and Automatic Weather Station (AWS) data.
IMD_PUNE.licensing: Government of India Open Data / IMD Data Request Portal

WRD_MAHARASHTRA.name: Water Resources Department (WRD), Government of Maharashtra
WRD_MAHARASHTRA.description: Daily dam storage, live reservoir levels, and spillway discharge (cusecs) for Godavari Basin.
WRD_MAHARASHTRA.coverage: Nashik District Dam Network (Historical bulletins & monsoon daily flood logs)
WRD_MAHARASHTRA.licensing: Government of Maharashtra Public Water Information System

CWC_INDIA.name: Central Water Commission (CWC) - Godavari Basin Organization
CWC_INDIA.description: Hydrological observation stations, warning/danger level river gauge telemetry.
CWC_INDIA.coverage: Godavari River gauging stations at Nashik and downstream Niphad
CWC_INDIA.licensing: Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India

OPEN_METEO_ARCHIVE.name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5-Land / Reanalysis)
OPEN_METEO_ARCHIVE.description: Open-access hourly meteorological reanalysis combining ECMWF ERA5 with localized downscaling.
OPEN_METEO_ARCHIVE.coverage: Global 0.1° grid, including exact Nashik coordinates (20.00°N, 73.78°E)
OPEN_METEO_ARCHIVE.licensing: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0) / ECMWF License

NASA_POWER.name: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources)
NASA_POWER.description: Satellite-observed and assimilation model precipitation and surface wetness.
NASA_POWER.coverage: Point and regional grids across Nashik (1981-Present)

ISRO_CARTODEM.name: ISRO Bhuvan CartoDEM / USGS SRTM
ISRO_CARTODEM.description: High-resolution Digital Elevation Model (DEM) for elevation and slope gradient extraction.
ISRO_CARTODEM.coverage: Nashik terrain and Godavari riverbed corridor
ISRO_CARTODEM.licensing: Government of India / NRSC Data Policy

NMC_DISASTER_MANAGEMENT.name: Nashik Municipal Corporation (NMC) & District Disaster Management Cell
NMC_DISASTER_MANAGEMENT.description: Official ground flood warning (Blue Line) and danger (Red Line) markers.
parameters: Ramkund Danger Level (Red Line: ~35,000 cusecs / Dutondya Maruti chest level)
NMC_DISASTER_MANAGEMENT.coverage: Urban Nashik Riverfront and Panchavati Ghats
